The structure of Mn2N2O8 (MnN(ON2)2) is tetragonal with space group I4/mmm (No. 119); its unit cell contains 12 atoms across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mn centers in octahedral environments with four N and two O neighbors, while N is four-coordinate (three Mn, one O) and O is four-coordinate (one Mn, three N). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Mn octahedra, and Mn octahedra sharing corners and edges with four-vertex N-centered polyhedra.
